title: 屋外消火器ボックス
description: 商店街や駐車場の歩道脇に立つ、赤い屋外用の消火器格納箱です。亜鉛めっきのスタンドと台板、切妻のふた、点検窓付きの扉と取っ手、中の消火器と弁・取っ手・ホース、頂部の赤色表示灯（発光材質）、無地のラベル帯を造形しています。「消火器」などの文字・図記号、扉の開閉、消火器としての性能は含みません。 点検窓はGLB内の半透明（アルファブレンド）材質です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.350 × 1.350 × 0.305 m、2,216三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A red outdoor fire-extinguisher box on a stand for shopping streets and car parks. It models the galvanized stand and base plate, a gabled lid, a door with inspection window and handle, the extinguisher inside with valve head, handle and hose, a lit red indicator lamp on top and a blank label band. Text such as "fire extinguisher" and symbols, door motion and extinguisher performance are not included. The inspection window uses an alpha-blended GLB material. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.350 × 1.350 × 0.305 m; 2,216 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
